citation: s. 163.326, F.S. (created by ch. 2026-65); definitions s. 373.203(3)-(4), F.S.
quote: Local governments shall maintain the authority to exercise the powers and responsibilities for comprehensive planning and land development regulation granted by law with respect to large load customers.
conditions: The 2026 law expressly preserves local land-development authority over large-load customers, including data centers.
A large load customer may not be treated as an electric substation for s. 163.3208.

Not class-specific: ch. 2025-190 (SB 180) s. 28 (uncodified; enrolled text https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2025/180/BillText/er/HTML) bars each county listed in the disaster declarations DR-4806, DR-4828 and DR-4834, and municipalities in them, from adopting more restrictive or burdensome amendments to land development regulations before October 1, 2027 (and moratoria on construction of hurricane-damaged property); such amendments are null and void ab initio. Which counties are listed was not read from the declarations. Not checked whether 2026 legislation amended s. 28.
No Florida statute found preempting local zoning of warehouse or distribution uses. The SB 180 s. 28 general cap (see the datacenter row) applies in the listed counties until 2027-10-01.
No Florida statute found preempting local zoning of heavy industrial or hazardous-materials uses. Not exhaustively searched.

quote: may not enact or enforce a resolution, ordinance, rule, code, or policy or take any action that restricts or prohibits or has the effect of restricting or prohibiting the types or fuel sources of energy production which may be used, delivered, converted, or supplied by the following entities to serve customers that such entities are authorized to serve:
conditions: s. 366.032(1)(e) preempts local restrictions on LP gas as a fuel source supplied by licensed LP gas dealers; it does not address zoning or siting of LP gas storage.
Ch. 527, F.S. (LP gas safety) was not read in this step; triage reports that it does not displace local zoning.

quote: Regulation of cultivation, processing, and delivery of marijuana by medical marijuana treatment centers is preempted to the state except as provided in this subsection.

setbacks.from: real property of a public or private elementary, middle or secondary school

conditions: Applies to medical marijuana treatment centers only.
A county or municipality may ban dispensing facilities by ordinance (s. 381.986(11)(b)1.); dispensing is outside this class.
Local building and fire code enforcement is preserved (s. 381.986(11)(d)).

Effective date is that of ch. 2017-232 (https://laws.flrules.org/2017/232: approved by the Governor June 23, 2017; takes effect upon becoming a law), which created the subsection; later amendments to s. 381.986 were not traced to subsection (11).
The effect value is a judgement call: 'preempted to the state' could also be read as local_ban_preempted.

citation: ss. 403.503, 403.506, 403.511(3), F.S. (Florida Electrical Power Plant Siting Act)
quote: The certification and any order on land use and zoning issued under this act shall be in lieu of any license, permit, certificate, or similar document required by any state, regional, or local agency pursuant to, but not limited to, chapter 125, chapter 161, chapter 163, chapter 166,
conditions: Covers only an electrical power plant as defined in s. 403.503: a steam or solar electrical generating facility; facilities under 75 MW are outside the Act unless the applicant elects certification (state_siting_optional below 75 MW).
Non-steam generation such as simple-cycle combustion turbines is outside the Act.

s. 163.3205(3) makes a solar facility a permitted use in all agricultural land use categories and agricultural zoning districts in unincorporated areas, and caps county buffer and landscaping requirements (s. 163.3205(4)).
Effective date not established: the history note lists ch. 73-33 through ch. 2018-34 and the act that last changed subsection (3) was not identified.

quote: Consists principally of photovoltaic modules, a mounting or racking system, power inverters, transformers, collection systems, battery systems, fire suppression equipment, and associated components.
conditions: No statute found preempting local zoning of stand-alone battery energy storage.
Battery systems that are part of a solar facility fall under s. 163.3205.
s. 163.3208 limits local rules for electric substations to setback, landscaping, buffering, screening, lighting and aesthetic standards; whether that reaches co-located storage is unclear.

No statute preempting local zoning of data centers was found. Triage reported only a sales tax exemption; it was not read in this step, and the status of 2024-2026 data-center bills was not confirmed on the legislature's site.
No statute found limiting local zoning of warehouse or distribution uses. The search was not exhaustive and was not confirmed against the legislature's site.

citation: O.C.G.A. 12-8-79; Ga. L. 1979, p. 1127, s. 21 (Georgia Hazardous Waste Management Act)
quote: no action, ordinance, regulation or law of any county, municipality or other political subdivision shall operate to prevent the location or operation of a hazardous waste facility holding a valid Hazardous Waste Facility Permit
conditions: Narrow: applies only to hazardous waste treatment, storage or disposal facilities that hold a state permit; not general heavy industry or chemical plants.
The same section lets a local government challenge a facility's compliance with the Act or its permit.

Primary-host exception: the URL is the Digital Library of Georgia scan of the 1979 session laws (University System of Georgia), not the legislature's own site, which has no copy of the 1979 act. The current codified text of O.C.G.A. 12-8-79 was not read.
Effective upon approval by the Governor (Section 24); approved April 16, 1979.

quote: No governmental entity of this state shall adopt any policy that restricts or prohibits, or has the effect of restricting or prohibiting, based on the type or source of energy or fuel to be delivered or the appliance to be used:
conditions: Preempts fuel-type bans on LP gas connection and sales of liquefied petroleum gas. It does not mention zoning, siting or bulk storage, so local zoning of LP gas facilities is not shown to be preempted; the effect value is a judgement call (the Florida row for a similar statute is none_found).
The bill PDF interleaves line numbers with the text; the quote matches once line-number lines are removed.
Effective upon approval by the Governor; the approval date was not read from a primary page.

quote: No licensee shall operate in any location, whether for cultivation, harvesting, and processing of marijuana or for processing, manufacturing, packaging, or distributing low THC oil, within a 3,000 foot radius of a covered entity

setbacks.from: a covered entity, property boundary to property boundary (state rule, in addition to local zoning)

conditions: No clause preempts or occupies local zoning of production or processing.
Dispensing is outside this class; local rules for dispensing licensees were not checked.

quote: No county or municipal corporation shall impose on a grantee who has entered into a solar power facility agreement that conforms to the requirements of this Code section financial assurance requirements relating to the removal or decommissioning of solar power facilities.
conditions: Narrow: caps only local decommissioning-bond requirements for solar leased under a conforming agreement.
No state siting preemption for generating plants was found; whether a Public Service Commission certificate displaces zoning was not checked.
The bill PDF interleaves line numbers with the text; the quote matches once line-number lines are removed.
No battery storage siting preemption was found. The search was not exhaustive and was not confirmed against the legislature's site.

quote: Nothing in this section shall be construed to prohibit, limit, or otherwise supersede existing local zoning authority.
conditions: Procedural only: for a new high energy use facility (100 MW or more) the locality must require a sound-profile site assessment and a utility substation and transmission form before approving a rezoning, special exception or special use permit.

Scanned Va. Code Title 15.2 ch. 22 (planning and zoning); 'warehousing' appears only in definitions and farm winery, brewery and distillery provisions. Chapters 9 and 21 were reported scanned by triage.

quote: The Fire Prevention Code shall prescribe regulations to be complied with for the protection of life and property from the hazards of fire or explosion and for the handling, storage, sale, and use of fireworks, explosives, or blasting agents
conditions: A fire code, not a siting preemption. No preemption found in the zoning title.
No 'propane' or 'liquefied petroleum' in Va. Code Title 15.2 ch. 22; triage also reports none in ch. 9, ch. 21 or Title 27 ch. 9.

citation: Va. Code § 4.1-629 A and C (2026, Sp. Sess. I, c. 1)
quote: No county, city, or town shall, except as provided in § 4.1-630, adopt any ordinance or resolution that regulates or prohibits the cultivation, processing, possession, sale, distribution, handling, transportation, consumption, use, advertising, or dispensing of marijuana or marijuana products in the Commonwealth.
conditions: Subsection C preserves 'local zoning and land use requirements' for licensed businesses: an outright local ban is preempted, but districting, special use permits and standards stay local.
No local opt-out or referendum provision was found in Title 4.1 chapters 6-16.
Effective date not established: the section page shows none, and the 2026 Special Session I chapter page was not reachable.

quote: Vegetative visual screening requirements shall not be required to exceed three feet at planting, shall be between 25 and 50 feet wide, and shall allow for consideration of preexisting natural or manmade visual barriers.
conditions: Applies only to ground-mounted solar of 1 MW or more serving other property; the locality uses a special exception or a siting agreement (§ 15.2-2316.7) and keeps its criteria within statutory ranges.
A locality need not approve any application.

Setback ranges (not fixed values): 150-200 ft from occupied dwellings and community buildings on nonparticipating property; 50-100 ft from roadbed; 50 ft (25 MW or less) or 100 ft (over 25 MW) from wetlands and perennial streams; 100-125 ft in Chesapeake Bay Preservation Areas; 50-75 ft from nonparticipating property lines; panel height 25 ft or less at full tilt.
Other generation types: no preemption found.
Effective date not established: the section page shows none for the 2026 amendments.

quote: Such battery energy storage project shall not require a special exception or be subject to any other local land use approval.
conditions: Only for storage within a parcel that already has an approved special exception for a solar facility, with rated storage capacity of 100% or less of that facility's nameplate capacity; it is then deemed a permitted accessory use in all zoning districts.
Stand-alone energy storage remains under local special exception (§ 15.2-2288.8 B) or optional siting agreements (§ 15.2-2316.7).
Effective date not established: the section page shows none.
